notes: v4: awns tightened to near-parallel, ears droop slightly. Reads as ripe awned winter wheat at ear distance and as a dense field at standing height. 84 tris per clump; texture memory 6 MB per texture pair.

defects.text: Colour variation between culms is mild (two textures); a field-scale tint will come from per-instance colour in the game.
defects.fix: Handled by instance colour in dev.game.js.
